# Manual Test Case Generation Instructions

This file only routes relevant edits. For testcase requirements, formats, and controlled values, use [manual-test-case-rules.md](../rules/manual-test-case-rules.md). For the end-to-end creation and review workflow, use the `manual-test-case-creation` skill.
